title: Evaluating Travel Options
description: Use this when planning a journey with multiple departure times and constraints.
content: Always compare the directness of routes and potential transfer times before selecting a departure. Prioritize options that meet arrival time constraints while minimizing travel complexity.

title: Optimizing Ticket Selection
description: Use this when choosing between different fare classes or departure times.
content: Check for off-peak pricing or specific fare conditions associated with different departure times to minimize costs. Factor in additional fees like seat reservations when calculating the total price.

title: Finalizing Travel Logistics
description: Use this when completing a booking process to ensure a smooth departure.
content: After selecting a service, secure specific seat preferences and set a reminder for the departure platform and time. Always confirm the booking to receive a reference number and finalize the travel plan.

title: Calculating Tournament Structure
description: Use this when organizing a knockout tournament to determine the necessary number of rounds and time requirements.
content: Calculate the number of rounds by determining how many times the field must be halved to reach a single winner. Once the round count is established, allocate specific time slots for both gameplay and mandatory breaks to ensure the event fits within the allotted timeframe.

source.task_query: set up a 16-player chess knockout that finishes in one afternoon. The organiser says each round halves the field.

title: Strategic Player Seeding
description: Use this when setting up tournament brackets to ensure competitive balance.
content: Seed players based on their skill ratings to prevent top-ranked participants from facing each other in the early stages. By pairing the highest seeds against the lowest seeds, you ensure that the most skilled players progress to the final rounds.
